estimates: Unaltered mapped ground and the connected building outline are used. The number and distribution of vaults, exact glazing, dimensions above the footprint, colour, and west doorway detailing are modeled estimates.

Kerma’s 2008-built museum form is represented. The standing connected ranges follow the single mapped outline. Internal room attribution, exhibits, the Western Deffufa and other cultural precinct properties are outside the reconstruction.

review.notes: Started with the published Qualla gallery. Its public-domain material documents collections rather than the building, and its exterior image requires attribution. The model uses the mission’s written architectural facts, the mapped museum envelope and original elevation data. No photos or plans were used.
